VBAT 11.1 V from SW1: load 10.701 A typical, 27.001 A peak; source 35 A cont, 70 A peak; fuse 15 A
5V 5 V from U5: load 1 A typical, 5 A peak; source 5.5 A cont, 8 A peak
Fuses: F1 15 A (everything on VBAT), F2 2 A (branch regulator_5v), F3 2 A (branch servo_bus), F4 2 A (branch head_pan_actuator), F5 3 A (branch
left_arm_base_yaw_actuator), F6 3 A (branch right_arm_base_yaw_actuator). Branch fuses sit inline in the lead they protect.
Lever splices (servo_bus_hub, star_ground, splice_vbat) are junctions of their nets.
Same net label or power symbol = same conductor. X = pin not connected.
